releases.notes:
## New                                                                             
  - **Trailing arguments** — add extra words when running a shortcut and they get    
  appended to the command                                                            
    Example: `/scm add +/enchant macswag_+ enchantme` → `/sc enchantme protection 4`
  runs `/enchant macswag_ protection 4`                                              
   
  - **Chaining** — save multiple shortcuts as a sequence using `-name-` syntax       
    Example: `/scm add +-givetome--apple--protenchantments-+ mychain` → `/sc mychain`
   runs all three in order                                                           
    Chains are live references — editing a component shortcut updates the chain
  automatically                                                                      
                                                            
  ## Changed
  - `/scm alias delete <name> related` on a chain now also deletes the shortcuts
  listed inside it                                                                   
  - `/scm list` and `/sc` tab completion are now sorted alphabetically
  - Chains show their components in `/scm list` and `/scm list <name>`

mods.name: nameshort
mods.description: nameshort lets you create personal command shortcuts so you can run long or complex commands instantly. Use /scm add +/command+ name to save a shortcut, then run it anytime with /sc name. Shortcuts support tab completion, are saved per player, and persist across restarts. Manage your shortcuts with /scm list, /scm edit, /scm delete, and /scm delete all. Create aliases for existing shortcuts with /scm alias, and remove them individually or along with everything pointing to the same command using /scm alias delete name related.

releases.notes:
## NEW!

- added more detailed mod info for compatibility with multimc/prism launcher mod info

## WARNING!!!
Please delete old config file if you are updating to this version. The new mod version expects a different format!

## NEW!                                                                                   
  - Per-player shortcuts — each player has their own shortcut list stored by UUID                                                                           
  - Aliases — /scm alias <name> <alias> to create a second name for a shortcut                                                                              
  - /scm alias delete <alias> — remove just that alias                                                                                                      
  - /scm alias delete <alias> related — remove alias + everything pointing to the same command                                                              
  - Edit — /scm edit <name> +/newcommand+ to update a shortcut without deleting it                                                                          
  - /scm delete all — wipe all your shortcuts at once                                                                                                       
  - Split commands: /scm for management, /sc for running                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                            
## Changed                                                                                                                                               
  - /sc <name> now only shows your own shortcut names on tab (no subcommand clutter)                                                                        
  - Shortcuts stored per player UUID in nameshort_shortcuts.json

NEW!
  - Tab completion — shortcut names now suggest when typing /sc delete, /sc    
  list, and /sc <name>                                                         
  - Mod renamed to NameShort (the actual .jar file)
